And one more wonderful experience with Mr. Handyman to finish out my ‘I really need to get this done’ 2025 list. It was a big project, our back porch was a disaster. Screens blown out, wood rotted, door hinges barely hanging on. Pete came out to tackle this project as he had worked on our other projects this year and we had great experiences both times.  And he was incredible, again.  He explained every step he was going to take to fix the various things that needed attention. He noticed things that we didn’t. For example, the door was warped, he figured out a way to help straighten it out without needing to replace it.
This was a multi-day project and Pete showed up cheery and energetic every day.  He really loves his job and it shows in his attention to detail, the quality of his work and his basic, ‘it’s all good’ attitude.
I’m sure I will have a ‘I really need to get this done’ list for 2026. Without a doubt, I’ll be calling Mr. Handyman and Pete.
